name: KeyController — SSH Key Manager
author: KeyController contributors
description: SSH key manager for Omarchy with biometric fingerprint unlock or key passwords (passphrases). Let AI agents such as Codex and Claude Code, apps and deployment scripts request access through kctrl. Manage existing SSH keys with per-key timers, instant revocation and optional revoke-before-sleep. Works with the standard OpenSSH agent for SSH and Git.

barWidget.description: SSH keys, fingerprint unlock and access timers
